title: Railway Employees Liberalized Health Scheme (RELHS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Post-retirement medical benefit scheme for eligible retired railway employees and specified family members.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible retired railway employees and family/dependants covered under Railway health-service rules and RELHS conditions.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Railway Employees Liberalized Health Scheme (RELHS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
